Email

Business email on your own domain

Professional addresses come with your website. Each mailbox has 10GB of storage. We set up the agreed mailboxes and send the settings you need.

What is included

  • Addresses on your domain

    Mail uses the same domain as the website, such as a name at your business address.

  • Mailbox setup

    The agreed mailboxes are created at the start, with the settings to add them to your mail app.

  • Further help

    Help with a mail app on a particular phone or computer is arranged separately. Additional mailboxes can be added by arrangement.

Email that uses your domain

Mailbox setup is part of the website service. The client area is for your website project. Hosting login is for an existing hosting account.
